ety.hint: A freshly chopped 斤 tree 亲

origin.says: 辛 (bitter) as the sound plus 斤 (axe) for the meaning, chopping wood: firewood. 木 (tree) was added and merged with 辛 into the left part. The word new was borrowed for the sound; firewood got 薪.

ety.hint: Simple words 八 coming from the mouth 口

origin.says: 口 (mouth) with two strokes below showing breath drawn downward: a sentence-final particle, later 'only'. Simplification also took it over for 隻 (a hand holding one bird, a single one) and 衹 (only).
origin.src: CUHK; Wiktionary (local copy); Dong Chinese (local copy)

ety.hint: An eye 巳 pierced by a dagger 戈, an old mark of slavery

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show an eye pierced by a sharp point, perhaps marking blinded captives or slaves; how that became 'the people' is unclear.
Two 人 (people), one behind the other: to follow, hence from. The traditional 從 added walking parts; the simplified form goes back to the ancient 从.

从.name: follow
从.in: 众坐座碎纵醉粹丛挫诬耸巫卒悴翠

origin.says: 辶 (walking) plus 首 (head), which also gives the sound; bronze forms put 首 inside 行 (crossroads) with a foot. The road, then the way, method, and to say.

问.def: to ask about, to inquire after

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 门 (gate) as the sound: to ask; a word related to 闻 (to hear), 'let me hear'. Simplified from 問, with 門 written 门.

问.name: ask

间.def: between, among; midpoint; space, place, locality

ety.hint: The sun 日 shining through a doorway 门

origin.says: Light seen through a gap in a door (门): first the moon (月), later 日 (sun), hence gap, between, room. Simplified from 間 with 門 in its short form.

间.name: gap

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 里 (village) as the sound: to work jade along its grain, hence order, reason, logic, to manage.

ety.hint: A table 几 made of wood 木; 几 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: An old character, 木 (wood) with 几 (small table) as the sound, taken over as the simplified form of 機 (木 + 幾 sound: a trigger, loom mechanism), hence machine.

ety.hint: Road 丨 leading to the farm 田

origin.says: Origin unsettled: early forms are 口 (a mouth or vessel shape) with a vertical stroke or circle on top. Readings: 丨 (needle) as a sound part, new shoots growing from a plant, or a pomelo fruit; a helmet reading is rejected. 'From, cause' are borrowed senses.
origin.src: CUHK; Wiktionary (local copy); Dong Chinese (local copy)

由.name: cause
由.in: 演油届袖邮抽宙聘庙迪轴笛寅

起.def: to begin, to initiate; to rise, to stand up

origin.says: 走 (walk) for the meaning plus a sound part, first 巳 (snake), later written 己 (self): to rise and set off.

起.name: rise

着.def: to make a move, to take action

origin.says: Began as a handwritten variant of 著 (艹 grass + 者 as the sound part), whose grass top ran together with the strokes below into a 羊-like (sheep) top and 目 (eye). The variant took over the senses attach, touch and the grammar word.

着.name: attached

ety.hint: A man 人  entering a door 冂

origin.says: 入 (enter) inside 冂 (a hall or outskirts): going in, inside. Simplified from 內; the 入 is now written as 人 and crosses the frame, so it is not split.

ety.hint: A spade or other workman's tool

origin.says: A drawing of a tool: usually read as a carpenter's square, another reading a rammer or plough blade. Hence 'work, skill, worker'.

工.name: work
工.in: 式空功试项控差筑左攻红恐江贡毁巧巩虹杠诬扛腔惰搓窍缸汞巫佐肛拭鸿隋髓赣

ety.hint: The heavens 一 above a man 大

origin.says: A standing person 大 (big, a frontal man) with the head marked by a line on top: the top of the head, then the sky above it, heaven.

天.name: sky
天.in: 关联送误娱奏舔添凑吞揍郑掷吴蚕葵癸蜈

ety.hint: One step 彳 coming behind another 夂; 幺 provides the pronunciation

想.def: to believe, to wish for; to consider, to plan, to think

origin.says: 心 (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 相 (look at) as the sound and hint: picturing something in the mind, to think or wish.

想.name: think

及.def: to extend; to reach; and; in time

origin.says: A hand 又 (hand) reaching a person 人 (person) from behind: catching up with someone, hence to reach, to be in time for, and 'and'. The two parts now cross into one shape.

及.name: reach

已.def: already; finished; to stop; then, afterwards

origin.says: In early script the same character as 巳 (a fetus or snake shape); the two were later told apart by a small gap in a stroke, with 已 taking the sense 'stop, already'.

已.name: already

origin.says: A picture of a face outline with an eye 目 (eye) inside it: the face, then surface and side. In simplified writing it also stands for 麵 (noodles), 麥 (wheat) with 面 as the sound.
A picture of a heart, now highly stylized; the heart was seen as the seat of the mind.

心.name: heart
心.in: 想意怎总感思息态德念愿志您虑恶稳恐急忘隐悲忍忽患怒悉愈惠惑慧聪憾惩愚忠怨恩慰慈恋悬媳悠滤闷忌撼恳瘾恕惫憋葱熄愁惹蟋穗怠忿

ety.hint: Dividing 八 by a line 亅

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms are three small dots, like grains of sand: a picture of smallness. The dots later became strokes, which led an old dictionary to misread it as 八 (divide) plus a line.

小.name: small
小.in: 你原称源愿您督尔孙叔尖寂戚弥僚尘逊椒雀隙淑撩嘹缭穆瞭

於.def: at, in, on; to, from; alas!

种.def: race, kind, breed; seed; to plant

origin.says: Simplified from 種: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 重 (heavy) as the sound, seed and planting, then kind or breed. The simplified form swaps 重 for 中 (middle), which sounds alike.

种.name: seed

部.def: department, ministry; division, unit; part, section

origin.says: 咅 (spit) as the sound plus 阝 (town, on the right) for the meaning: first a place name; later 'part, section, department'.

部.name: department

重.def: heavy, weighty; to double, to repeat

ety.hint: A burden carried for a thousand 千 miles 里

origin.says: A person 人 (person) carrying a bag 東 (bag, also the sound), with 土 (earth) added below for the ground: heavy; also to repeat. The parts have fused into one shape.

重.name: heavy

ety.hint: Simplified form of 電; lightning 申 from a storm cloud 雨

origin.says: From 電: 雨 (rain) over 申, which first drew a zigzag lightning flash and also gives the sound. The simplified form drops 雨 and keeps the lightning.
Simplified from 題: 頁 (head) for the meaning plus 是 (this) as the sound, with 頁 written in the short form 页. It first meant the forehead, then the heading of a text: title, topic, question.
Early forms draw a wooden digging tool or simple plough, the work that took a farmer's strength; so 'strength, force'. One older reading instead saw an arm or muscle.

力.name: strength
力.in: 动加别务历男边助功另势伤努劳励架勇穷驾咖幼抛勒劫勤劲劝雾劣勉贺嘉勋虏捞拐茄舅筋募勘唠勃瘸雳锄夯肋沥拗荔捌涝甥渤

意.def: thought, idea, opinion; desire, wish; meaning, intention

origin.says: Now 音 (sound) over 心 (heart): the intention of the heart, known by what one says, idea, meaning. One reading holds that the top was not 音 at first but a form of 言 (speech), so the build is uncertain.

意.name: idea

ety.hint: Jade 玉 put away 入 for safe-keeping

origin.says: 入 (enter) over 玉 (jade): a flawless piece of jade, whole, complete. The modern shape writes 入 like 人 (person) and the jade without its dot as 王 (king).

合.def: to combine, to join, to unite; to gather

origin.says: A drawing of a lid (the top 亼) closing over a container (口, mouth or opening): to close, fit together, join. Another reading sees two mouths facing each other.

合.name: join
合.in: 给拿答哈搭塔拾盒恰洽鸽瘩蛤

origin.says: 彳 (step) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound. It first meant 'disobedient, cruel' (like 狠 ruthless); much later it was borrowed for 'very'.

ety.hint: A place 匸 under a lord's control 乂

origin.says: Traditional 區 shows 品 (many things) inside 匚 (an enclosure): things kept in a place, hence area, district. The simplified form replaced 品 with the shorthand cross 乂.

让.def: to allow, to permit, to yield

origin.says: Traditional 讓 is 言 (speech) plus 襄 as the sound: to decline politely, to yield, to let. The simplified form uses 讠 for speech and 上 (up), which sounds alike in some dialects, as the new sound part.

让.name: let

ety.hint: Fruit 田 growing on a tree 木

origin.says: A tree 木 (tree) with round fruit on top; the fruit became the 田-like part, unrelated to 田 (field). Fruit, and then the fruit of an action: result.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 長; an old man with long hair and a cane

origin.says: Simplified from 長, a drawing of an old man with long flowing hair (sometimes with a cane): 'long', and also 'elder, to grow'. The simplified form is a cursive shortening.

ety.hint: A straight 直 (that is, level) table 几

origin.says: Bronze forms join 贝 (shell, wealth) for the meaning with 𠂈 (an old sign for falling headlong) as the sound; 贝 was often swapped for 鼎 (cauldron). One reading takes it as the first form of 珍 (treasure). The modern 十 (ten) over 具 (tool) is only a later shape.

ety.hint: A woman 女 beside you 也

origin.says: 女 (woman) plus 也 (also), the right side of 他 (he): a modern character made around 1920 to write 'she' apart from 'he'.
A round mouth 口 (circle) over a cooking pot that later turned into 贝 (shell): 'round', the original form of 圆 (round). The meaning member, staff is a sound loan. Simplified from 員 (貝 to 贝).
Simplified from 點: 黑 (black) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound, a small black dot. The simplified form keeps 占 and only the four dots 灬 from the bottom of 黑.

应.def: should, must; to respond, to handle; to deal with, to cope

origin.says: Simplified from 應: 心 (heart) for the meaning plus 䧹 (a hawk) as the sound: to answer, to respond; also should. The simplified form comes from cursive writing.

应.name: respond

表.def: to show, to express, to display; outside, appearance; a watch

ety.hint: Fur 毛 clothing 衣; a shawl or wrap

origin.says: 衣 (clothing) with 毛 (fur) inside it: the fur coat worn outermost, hence outside, surface, to show. The parts have fused into 龶 over 𧘇; simplification also uses it for 錶 (watch).

表.name: outer coat

正.def: straight, right, proper, correct, just, true

ety.hint: A foot 止 stopping in the right place 一

origin.says: A foot 止 (stop, foot) marching toward a walled town, drawn as a square that later became one stroke: going on a campaign, now written 征 (campaign). One reading takes the square as 丁 (nail) for the sound. Then 'straight, correct'.

正.name: upright

给.def: to give, to lend; for, by

origin.says: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 合 (join) as the sound; originally to supply or provide enough, silk being a precious gift. Simplified from 給, with the silk part written 纟.

给.name: give

加.def: to add to, to increase, to augment

ety.hint: Supporting a cause with the strength 力 of one's words 口

origin.says: 力 (strength, or a plow) plus 口 (mouth): effort with a shout, or words added on. One reading says 'to exaggerate', another 'to put in more effort'; either way it became 'to add, to increase'.

加.name: add

origin.says: A hand, now one stroke 丿, holding strands of silk 糸 (thread): threads tied together, connect, system. As a simplified character it also stands for 係 and 繫.

制.def: system; to establish; to manufacture; to overpower

origin.says: A tree (the left part, now a 未-like shape) with 刂 (knife): cutting and shaping wood, to make; hence to control, a system. Simplification folded 製 (to make clothes) into it.

制.name: system

体.def: body; group, class; form, style, system

origin.says: Stands for 體 (bone + a ritual vessel as the sound). 体 is an old popular form, 亻 (person) plus 本 (root): a person's foundation, the body. It was adopted to replace the complex form.

体.name: body

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 青 (blue-green) as the sound: what the heart feels, emotion.
心 (heart, mind) for the meaning plus 乍 (suddenly) as the sound: a late character, written for the spoken word "how", which grew from a phrase meaning "to do what".
Draws a standing person seen from the front with a pattern tattooed or painted on the chest: pattern, marks, and later writing and culture. The chest mark has since dropped out.

文.name: writing
文.in: 这济脑刘齐剂挤浏恼坟斑悯蚊纹吝紊脐斋斌

或.def: or, either, else; maybe, perhaps, possibly

ety.hint: To defend yourself 口 with a spear 戈; "or else"

origin.says: 戈 (halberd) guarding 口 (an enclosed area) with a line for its border: a defended territory, the original of 國 (country) and 域 (region). It was borrowed for 'or, perhaps'. One source reads 口 as a sound part instead.

或.name: or perhaps

origin.says: A picture of a net stretched on a frame, with crossing mesh lines. 網 later added 糸 (silk) and 罔 (net) as the sound; the simplified form went back to the old picture.

ety.hint: To stare 目 at a tree 木, meaning to observe

origin.says: 目 (eye) + 木 (tree): an eye looking closely at a tree, to observe. It was borrowed for 'each other, mutually'.

计.def: to calculate, to count; to plan, to reckon; plot, scheme

origin.says: Simplified from 計: 言 (speech) plus 十 (ten, all): counting everything aloud, so to calculate, to plan. Some sources take 十 as the sound. 言 became 讠.

计.name: calculate

origin.says: Simplified from 該: 言 (speech) became 讠. 讠 (speech) gives the meaning and 亥 (twelfth earthly branch) the sound; the word was used for what one is bound to do, 'ought to'.
Simplified from 資: 次 (next) as the sound plus 貝 (shell money) for the meaning, with 貝 written 贝: property, resources, funds.

代.def: era, generation; to substitute for, to replace

ety.hint: A man 亻 caught 弋 by the passing of time

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 弋 (stake) as the sound: one person taking another's place, to replace; then a generation or era that replaces the last.

代.name: stand-in

外.def: out, outside, external; foreign; in addition

ety.hint: Night-time 夕 divinations 卜; the supernatural, the foreign

origin.says: 卜 (divination crack) with a part that was once 月 (moon), now written 夕 (evening). One reading takes 月 as the sound; another reads it as divining by night or by the moon, outside the rule. Meaning: outside.

外.name: outside

产.def: to give birth, to bring forth, to produce

origin.says: Simplified from 產: a shortened 彥 (accomplished man) as the sound plus 生 (to be born) for the meaning, 'to give birth, to produce'. The simplified form drops 生 and keeps only the top: 立 (stand)-like part over 厂 (cliff).

产.name: produce

提.def: to hold in the hand; to lift, to raise

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 是 (this) as the sound: to hold something up in the hand, to lift; then to raise a subject, to mention.

提.name: lift

活.def: to exist, to live, to survive; living, working

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus an old sound part (氏 over 口) that later took the shape of 舌 (tongue): first the sound of flowing water, then 'alive, living'.

活.name: alive

认.def: to know, to recognize, to understand

origin.says: Simplified from 認: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 忍 (endure) as the sound, to recognize or acknowledge. The simplified form writes 言 as 讠 and swaps 忍 for the simpler 人 (person), which has a similar sound.

认.name: recognize

origin.says: A drawing of a tall building on a base, a tower; hence tall, high. Compare 京 (capital), another tall building.

结.def: knot, tie; to connect, to join

origin.says: Simplified from 結: 糸 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 吉 (lucky) as the sound: to tie a knot. 糸 became 纟.

结.name: knot

者.def: that which; they who; those who

origin.says: Origin unclear. Old forms show a plant-like top, dots and a 口 (mouth); one reading sees sugarcane with dripping juice (the original of 蔗, sugarcane, or 煮, boil), others leave it unexplained. Borrowed for its sound as the grammar word 'the one who'. The top is not 老 (old).

者.name: one who
者.in: 都著署绪猪赌储屠诸煮堵暑睹奢薯曙

此.def: this, these; in this case, then

origin.says: 止 (foot) next to a person (人, now shaped like 匕 spoon): where a person stops, 'here, this'. Another reading takes it as a sound compound; the sources disagree.

此.name: this

期.def: a period of time; date, time; phase

origin.says: 其 (basket) as the sound plus a time part, first 日 (sun), later 月 (moon): a set time, a period, an appointed date.

期.name: period

ety.hint: A woman turned to the side

origin.says: A drawing of a woman kneeling with her arms crossed in front of her; the modern form keeps only traces of the arms and legs.

女.name: woman
女.in: 要好如她数始接安案委按妈婚媒努威姐妇楼妹婆娘姓娱奶怒姑姻奴姿妙婴妥妨姨嫁娶娜姆媳嫌娃腰耍樱嫩宴妮矮婪妒嫉妆婿屡妄姜恕嫂搂

ety.hint: Two spoons 匕 side-by-side; 匕 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Two people standing side by side, giving the idea of putting things together and comparing them. One reading takes both halves as 匕 (spoon) for the sound; both look like 匕 today.

比.name: compare
比.in: 批毕混皆屁谐庇棍昆毙揩楷

明.def: bright, clear; to explain, to understand, to shed light

ety.hint: The light of the sun 日 and moon 月

origin.says: 日 (sun) plus 月 (moon): light, bright, dawn. Some early forms have a window instead of the sun, moonlight shining in; the modern left part looks like 日.

明.name: bright

己.def: self, oneself; personal, private; 6th heavenly stem

origin.says: A picture, perhaps a winding cord for binding things (the first form of 纪, record). Borrowed for 'self'; one source calls its origin unclear. Not to be confused with 已 (already) or 巳 (snake).

己.name: oneself

使.def: cause, mission, orders; envoy, messenger, ambassador

ety.hint: A person 亻 working for the government 吏

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 吏 (official) as sound and meaning: a person sent out by the ruler, an envoy; hence to send, to make someone do, to use.

使.name: envoy

通.def: to pass through, to open, to connect; to communicate; common

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 甬 (bell) as the sound: to go through, to pass, to connect.

通.name: go through

更.def: more, further; to shift, to alternate; to modify

origin.says: Originally two 丙 (chariot parts) stacked; later 攴 (hand with stick, action) was added and one 丙 dropped. The parts then fused into one shape. Meaning to change, to take turns, and 'even more'.

更.name: even more

ety.hint: A spoken 讠 tongue 舌; 舌 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus a sound part that over time took the shape of 舌 (tongue), though it was a different part. Simplified from 話, with 言 written 讠.

把.def: to grasp, to hold; to guard, to take; handle

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 巴 as the sound: to grasp or hold in the hand; hence a handle and its grammar use.

把.name: grip

建.def: to build, to erect; to establish, to found

origin.says: Early forms show a hand setting up a pole on a base: to erect, to build. The hand and pole were later written like 聿 (brush), and the base became 廴 (stretch step).

建.name: build

立.def: to stand; to establish, to set up

ety.hint: A man standing on the ground 一

origin.says: A drawing of a person standing on the ground line: to stand, to set up.

立.name: stand
立.in: 新部意位站接亲境音拉章啦竟培障竞童暗端倍镜垃陪撞赔粒薪泣竖彰剖竣毅竭幢韵霎菩靖樟瞳黯赣

做.def: to work, to make; to act

ety.hint: Someone 亻 who causes things to happen 故; 故 also provides the pronuncation

origin.says: A later variant of 作 (to do), written 作 plus 攵 (hand with stick); 乍 was corrupted into 古 (old), so it now looks like 亻 (person) plus 故 (cause).

做.name: craft

别.def: to separate, to distinguish, to classify; to leave; other; do not, must not

ety.hint: To draw boundaries 刂 between classes 另

origin.says: 冎 (bones stripped of flesh) plus 刂 (knife): cutting meat from bone, to separate, then 'other' and 'don't'. Later the bone part was written like 另 (another).

别.name: separate

展.def: to open, to unfold; to extend, to stretch

ety.hint: Laying out clothes 㠭 for sale in a market 尸; compare 㠭

origin.says: 尸 (body) for the meaning plus a shortened sound part (fine clothing, with 㠭 'to spread') below: to spread out, unfold. The lower parts are worn down and no longer readable.

展.name: unfold

任.def: to trust, to rely on; to appoint; to bear; duty, office

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 壬 (carrying pole) as sound and meaning: a person bearing a load on the shoulder, hence to bear, take on a duty, appoint.

任.name: duty

origin.says: 爻 (crossed lines) as the sound with 子 (child) and 攵 (hand with a stick): teaching a child under authority. 爻 over 子 later took the shape of 孝 (filial), which some read as the sound part.

目.def: eye; to look, to see; division, topic

ety.hint: An eye drawn on its side

origin.says: A drawing of an eye, turned upright on its side.

目.name: eye
目.in: 看着想相算省眼督睡夏冒睛循盾箱厦泪瞧盲瞬瞒眠瞎瞄帽盯厢盼睹睁霜瞪眨眉瞅睦渺睬媚眶眯瞻湘瞩眷盹睐睫瞭瞳

设.def: to build, to design; to establish; to offer

origin.says: Simplified from 設: 言 (speech), shortened to 讠, plus 殳 (hand with a tool): ordering with words and setting things up. One reading takes 殳 as the sound; another says the right part was once a short form of 埶 (to plant).

设.name: set up

统.def: to govern, to command; to gather, to unite

origin.says: Simplified from 統: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 充 (fill) as the sound: the main thread that gathers the others, hence to unite and to govern.

统.name: unite

origin.says: The word 'not have' was written 無, a picture of a dancer borrowed for its sound. 无 is an old variant of unknown origin, used alongside it in early times and adopted as the simplified form.
A drawing of a snake, now written 蛇 (snake). It was borrowed for its sound as the pronoun 'it'. The modern shape looks like 宀 (roof) over 匕 (spoon) but that is not its origin.

位.def: seat, throne; rank, status; position, location

ety.hint: The place where a person 亻 stands 立

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 立 (stand): the place where a person stands, a position or rank. 立 also gives the sound; early texts wrote 立 alone for this word.

位.name: seat

市.def: city, town; market, fair; to trade

origin.says: In the oldest forms 之 (go to) gives the sound and 兮 (an exclamation, the bustle of a crowd) the meaning: a busy market. The parts have changed shape and the modern form reads as 亠 over 巾 (cloth).

市.name: market

场.def: field, open space; market, square; stage

origin.says: Simplified from 場: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 昜 (sunlit) as the sound, a levelled open ground for threshing or gatherings. The sound part is written in its cursive shape 𠃓.

场.name: open ground

origin.says: 牛 (ox) for the meaning plus 勿 (do not) as the sound; one reading takes the first sense as the varied colors of cattle, then 'kind', then 'thing'.
